title: PURA Final Decision — Docket 17-10-49: 192 North Street Class I

January 10, 2018

DECISION APPROVING
CLASS I CERTIFICATION

On October 24, 2017, the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority (Authority) received an application from Maple End Package Store (Applicant) requesting that the Authority determine that the solar facility located at 192 North Street in Bristol, Connecticut (Facility) qualifies as a Class I renewable energy source.

The Facility generates electricity using solar power. The Facility began commercial operation on May 5, 2017, and has an installed capacity of 0.0432 MW. Correspondence filed December 27, 2017; Additional Attachments. The Facility's New England Power Pool Generation Information System (NEPOOL GIS) Identification Number is NON116580. The facility is a behind-the-meter generation facility located in Connecticut and shall be subject to audits by the Authority.

The Facility has been accepted into The Connecticut Light and Power Company d/b/a Eversource Energy’s (CL&P) 15-year Zero Emissions Renewable Energy Credit Program and its electric generation output will be tracked by a CL&P Monitoring System. All of the electricity produced by the Facility will be either sold to CL&P or used at the location of the Facility.

The Authority reviewed all of the information in the record and finds that pursuant to §16-1(a)(20) of the General Statutes of Connecticut, the Facility qualifies as a Class I renewable energy source, effective July 1, 2017. The Authority assigns the Facility Connecticut Renewable Portfolio Standard Registration No. CT171049.

The Authority’s determination in this docket is based on the information submitted by the Applicant. The Authority may reverse its ruling or revoke the Applicant’s registration if any material information provided proves to be false or misleading. The Applicant is reminded that it is obligated to notify the Authority within 10 days of any changes to any of the information it has provided.

ORDER FOR APPLICANT

To comply with the Order below, the Applicant shall submit one original of the required documentation to the Executive Secretary, Ten Franklin Square, New Britain, CT 06051, and file an electronic version through the Authority's website at www.ct.gov/pura. Submissions filed in compliance with the Authority’s Orders must be identified by all three of the following: Docket Number, Title and Order Number.

Each Quarter, the Applicant shall file with the Authority, by the date indicated in the table below, the Quarterly Generation Report from the NEPOOL GIS that shows the number of renewable energy credits (RECs) created by the NEPOOL GIS Administrator based on the Class I activities of the Facility on the Creation Date [as defined in Section 2.1(b) of the NEPOOL GIS Operating Rules, as amended from time to time] for said quarter.
